parsed.rationale: Both participating records reside in test targets: 'Shared/AppServices/Tests/AppServicesTests/NowPlayingServiceTests.swift' and 'Shared/Artwork/Tests/ArtworkTests/ArtworkServiceTests.swift'. The shared name 'MockArtworkService' in both files confirms these are test-fixture mock objects. Per the decision rules, any cluster where a participating record is a test fixture warrants no-action, and here both records are test fixtures. Consolidating mock implementations across distinct test packages would couple unrelated test suites and undermine test isolation.
